title: The Antisocial Network (film)
short_description: 2024 film directed by Arthur Jones and Giorgio Angelini

text.lead: The Antisocial Network: Memes to Mayhem (or simply The Antisocial Network) is a 2024 documentary film directed by Arthur Jones and Giorgio Angelini that explores the intersection of internet culture and real-world politics. It was released as a follow-up to Jones' previous work, Feels Good Man. The film discusses the anonymous image board 4chan, and includes interviews from anonymous hackers and ex-members of the website. The film premiered at the 2024 South by Southwest Film Festival.
text.reception: On review aggregator Rotten Tomatoes, 94% of 17 critics gave the film a positive review, with an average rating of 7.0/10, earning it a "Fresh" rating.
